'''Bruce Mercy''' was a [[near-Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] from a high-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] world, who was associated with three other smugglers: [[Morph]], [[Durquist]], and [[Ptak-Sok]]. Mercy's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Black Widow]]'' acted as their command ship. The smugglers attempted to steal the location of the ''[[Fool's Gold]]'' from [[Plako]], but a group of freelance adventurers beat them to the legendary ship.
